title: When effort fails: Instances and reasons for effort-performance decoupling
title_zh: 当努力失败时：努力-表现解耦的实例与原因
abstract: Across domains, effort is often assumed to support performance, and performance is frequently used to infer effort. However, observed effort-performance relationships are less straightforward than these assumptions suggest, highlighting conditions under which effort and performance can become decoupled. Here, we review four broad factors that contribute to apparent decoupling: (1) system limits, (2) inefficiency and noise, (3) measurement mismatches, and (4) motivational misdirection. We show how these factors can underlie instances of concurrent decoupling (real-time) and prospective decoupling (over time) in the cognitive, as well as in the physical domain. By framing these factors ontologically as structural, statistical, epistemic, and psychological sources of decoupling, we identify commonalities in effort-performance relationships across research fields. We highlight how they can account for apparent non-linearities, including trade-offs and plateaus in the effort-performance relationship. This perspective can serve as a transdisciplinary agenda for studying effort-performance dynamics, helping researchers and practitioners to better describe, report, and understand effort-performance (de)coupling.
abstract_zh: 在各个领域，努力常被视为支持表现的因素，而表现也常被用来推断努力。然而，观察到的努力-表现关系并不像这些假设所暗示的那样直截了当，凸显了努力与表现可能解耦的条件。本文综述了导致表面解耦的四大类因素：（1）系统极限；（2）低效与噪声；（3）测量不匹配；（4）动机误导。我们展示了这些因素如何在认知领域以及物理领域中导致实时（并发）解耦和随时间推移的前瞻性解耦。通过将这些因素在本体论上归类为结构性、统计性、认知性和心理性解耦源，我们识别了跨研究领域的努力-表现关系的共性。我们强调它们如何解释表面上的非线性，包括努力-表现关系中的权衡与平台化。该视角可作为跨学科研究努力-表现动力学的议程，帮助研究者和从业者更好地描述、报告和理解努力-表现（解）耦合。
